utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many volunteers do we actually have for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve only heard of three for sure so far, but a couple more folks said they might join.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Three confirmed isn’t much—who are the maybes, and when will they confirm?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder and tool kit for the repair drive if that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d help a lot—thanks. I keep forgetting who’s bringing what, so a ladder and tools would be great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—I’ll bring the ladder and my tool kit, and I can get there a little early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, I heard folks are gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive this weekend—sounds like it’s shaping up nicely!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, but I hope someone’s keeping track of who’s bringing what so we don’t end up short on the basics.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely—I heard Mara started a little list, and I can ask around to make sure we’ve got the basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive—tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—I’m making a list by block, and Maple Street’s busted fence panels are first on it. If you can start there, I’ll note the next stop once we’ve got eyes on it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll head to Maple Street and take a look at those fence panels, then I’ll report back so we can line up the next stop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want to come by and help out?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe for a little while, if I can manage it. I’ve got some things going on, so I can’t promise much.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries at all—any time you can spare helps, and I’ll let a few more neighbors know too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m pulling together the repair drive list now; can you tell me which houses still need help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I only know that 12 Maple and 18 Oak still need help; I’ll send more if I hear back from the others.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo—that’s a helpful start. I’ll put down 12 Maple and 18 Oak for now, and you can send me any updates when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What details do we already have for the repair drive, Dane?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m a little late — so far I’ve only caught that we’re organizing a repair drive, but I’m missing the specifics.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries—before we do anything, let’s pin down the date, location, and what kinds of repairs we’re offering.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school drop-off and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, Faye—if you tell me your drop-off and pickup windows, I’ll make sure we slot you in around them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara—drop-off is around 7:45 to 8:30, and pickup is 2:45 to 3:30, so I’m free in between if that works.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard about the repair drive from Mara, but it sounds like folks are really trying to pull it together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s been nice seeing everyone pitch in—I’ve been looping a few different folks together so the tools and hands line up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear—I’m still piecing it together from what people tell me, but it sounds like it’s coming together better than I expected.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just tell me where to drop the tools and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s organizing it and the exact time before I commit?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think Sam’s coordinating it, and I’m pretty sure it starts around 9—let me double-check if you need exact details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard a little about it—what kind of repairs are folks focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly little fixes, I think—bikes, lamps, toasters, that sort of thing. I always mean to bring my wobbly chair and then forget it by the door.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds useful. If you bring the chair this time, I could stop by and see how it goes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, so I’ve been telling everyone the plan and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a lot—I've got extra tape, markers, and boxes set aside, so tell folks to meet by the community shed and we’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll keep repeating that everyone should meet by the community shed, and I’ll pass along that you’ve got the tape, markers, and boxes ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—keep me posted on the repair drive while I’m out, and I’ll help once I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do. I’ll let you know if anything changes before you get back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey—if anything urgent comes up, just text me and I’ll swing by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I meant to bring my toolbox, but I can still help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Oren—we’re still on for the repair drive, and I’ll let folks know you’re pitching in even without the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—I’ll head over in a bit and do whatever needs doing, just please remind me if I wander off track.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think I meant to bring some tools by, unless that got moved already?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still on for now—bring the tools if you can, and I’ll sort the rest when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, I’ll grab the toolbox and head over in a bit—unless I get turned around again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder and drill over for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help a lot, Gus. If you can come by around nine, we can make a clear plan and get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, I’ll swing by around nine with the ladder and drill so we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Quinn, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive going—what still needs organizing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We still need a few volunteers, a table for check-in, and someone to spread the word—I can start inviting folks on the block today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot—I can bring a folding table for check-in and put up a quick post to spread the word tonight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—want me to help round up folks from a few different circles so we get a good turnout?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d help a lot, Jules—if you can reach the church group, the block watch, and the parents from the school pickup line, I’ll keep track of who’s coming from where.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll reach out to all three groups today and send you a quick rundown so you can track the responses.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive schedule together, and I’d love your help making sure neighbors know when to bring things by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ve got a good sense of who still needs the details, so I can help spread the word and remind folks when to bring things by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be such a help, Cleo — I’ll send you the final times tonight, and maybe we can split the block so everyone gets a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—do you know if the repair drive’s still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, that’s what I heard—are you planning to bring tools or just chip in with supplies?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Probably just supplies—I’m still piecing things together second-hand, so I don’t want to show up with the wrong tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s start with the carpool van brakes, since I need it safe for school drop-offs this week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, brakes first then. Tell me who can look at it soonest, and I’ll work around that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Kira—what do you need me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s handling the tool check-in table before we start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can handle the tool check-in table unless someone’s already assigned to it.
